title: A novel sampling method for reconstruction of a moving point acoustic source in $\mathbb{R}^3$
summary: In this paper, we introduce a novel sampling method to recovering the trajectory of a moving point source in R^3, where both the spatial location and emission moment of the moving point source are unknown. Combining algebraic theory with geometric knowledge, we prove the uniqueness of the source location by using measured data from five observation points. Our sampling method constructs an indicator function based on the property that the residual of the time difference of arrival constraint formula vanishes at the true source location.
